decision.explanation: The provided documents contain conflicting assertions regarding Stephen Ralph Cartwright's spouse. Document 1 (D1S1, D1S3) explicitly states he was married to 'Lady Fanny Hay'. Document 2 (D2S2, D2S3) explicitly states he was married to 'Elizabeth Helen Rutt'. The prompt instructions require preserving all valid referents and not silently equating competing assertions with different entities, nor selecting a single favorite interpretation when distinct valid namesakes or complementary answers (in this case, contradictory historical claims) coexist in the source material. Both names are directly supported by specific source segments as the spouse.
